description: Turns MIDI generated by a hosted VST plugin into pitch, gates and clocks. It goes immediately to the right of a Host, Host-FX or Host-XL and takes the MIDI that module's plugin sends

outputs.text: 1V/oct pitch of the last note held
10V while a note is held; notes played legato do not restart it
Aftertouch, which is channel pressure rather than pressure per note
A clock pulse for every 24-PPQN MIDI clock that arrives
A clock at the division chosen by CLK/N rate in the menu
A trigger when the plugin sends a MIDI start event
A trigger when the plugin sends a MIDI stop event
A trigger when the plugin sends a MIDI continue event
A trigger for every new note, legato or not

notes: nothing reaches the outputs unless the VST plugin in the Host module at the left sends MIDI out of its own, as a sequencer or an audio-to-pitch detector does
click the display to take MIDI from one channel of the plugin instead of all of them; the choice is on the display, not on the panel menu
these MIDI expanders can be chained, each one passing the MIDI on to the module at its right
menu: CLK/N divider — the division the CLK/N output runs at: Whole, Quarter, 8th, 12 PPQN or 24 PPQN
Polyphony channels — how many channels the outputs carry, from Monophonic to 16
Polyphony mode — how incoming notes are handed to those channels: Rotate, Reuse, Reset or MPE
Panic — releases every note the module is holding at its gate outputs
